description_for_human: OAuth for email, simplified. Get Gmail access tokens for your users in three API calls.
description_for_model: inbox.dog handles the complete Google OAuth 2.0 flow for Gmail API access. Developers redirect their users to inbox.dog, users authenticate with Google, and the developer receives access_token and refresh_token that work directly with the Gmail API (gmail.googleapis.com). Three steps: 1) POST /api/keys to create credentials, 2) GET /oauth/authorize to start the flow, 3) POST /oauth/token to exchange the code for tokens. Supports scopes: email (read-only, default), email:read, email:send, email:full. Pricing: $0.10 per token exchange, 10 free credits on signup. Token refresh is free. Open source under MIT license.
